statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed for the weekend, so no live one-way Nasdaq price path is observable.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. Weekend geopolitical risk is reflected primarily in Stress until live price discovery resumes.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while geopolitical Stress remains extreme
body: NQ is closed, so fresh Iran/Hormuz sanctions risk and Russia-Ukraine escalation cannot be treated as observed Nasdaq trend structure. Conditional Tail rises narrowly into the Sunday Globex reopening, where gap behavior, extension and retracement quality become the key evidence.

lookbackSummary: All 24 prior clock-hour slots are available from previously published ChatGPT assessments. Tail stayed at 16% throughout the weekend closure while Stress rose from 92% to 97% as geopolitical headlines intensified.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low through most of Sunday, rises to WATCH ahead of Globex, and peaks at 24% in the reopening hour. A 25%+ block remains conditional on observed persistent extension, weak retracements and corroborating cross-asset structure after trading resumes.
